t: Titan TTB1351VAC 30Ltr wet and dry vacuum cleaner delivers strong suction for heavy-duty workshop clean-ups. The powerful 1400W vacuum is suitable for builders, plasterers and DIYers working on busy jobsites. Features a large 30Ltr stainless steel tank to handle dust, debris, sludge and water, with front drain hole for ease when emptying liquids. Integrated power take-off socket enables automatic operation when connected to power tools, whilst 2 castors and 2 fixed wheels provide easy transport around site. Also equipped with hose and cable collection for tidy working. Blower mode clears debris from hard-to-reach corners. Can be used with or without dust bags. Supplied with filter bag, foam sleeve, cartridge filter, floor nozzle, crevice tool, round brush and plastic wands.
b: Can be Used With or Without Dust Bags
